label: Compounds and stoichiometry
text: CH.O.A1.2 Compounds and stoichiometry. The law of definite proportions holds for daltonide compounds. Berthollide (non-stoichiometric) solids, such as wüstite Fe₁₋ₓO, are the stated exception.

warrant.standard: elemental analysis within stated error; IUPAC rule followed
